routes.failure: no purchase or any attribution/fulfillment break
routes.next_action_on_success: repeat same route before adding another product
routes.next_action_on_failure: change acquisition surface or proposition using observed evidence

routes.failure: no buyer after qualified exposure, or inventory/fulfillment cannot be proven
routes.next_action_on_success: list adjacent inventory with the same proven pattern
routes.next_action_on_failure: change price/surface/listing quality, not system architecture
